It is observed by this Court that the relevant factual matrix was duly recorded and considered by the Ld. Magistrate in the impugned order.
ATR filed by the police as well as the report of Vigilance Department were also considered by the Ld. Magistrate.
Having gone through the TCR, this Court must observe that the allegations levelled by the respondent are very grave and serious in nature.
The kind of evidence required to be collected in this case seems to be beyond the capability of any public person.
Recoveries might also need to be effected promptly.
The objections raised by the revisionist in the present proceedings are not sufficient to hold that the allegations levelled by the respondent are completely false and fabricated.
Infact, a formal investigation would rather substantiate as to whether or not the infirmities pointed out by the revisionist bear any merits.
In the entire facts and circumstances, this court does not find any reason to differ from the opinion of Ld. Magistrate.
The order passed by Ld. Magistrate does not seem to be arbitrary, perverse or irrational nor does it reflect any jurisdictional error which occasioned any injustice in the matter.
The present petition is devoid of any merits and is LOVLEEN hereby dismissed.
